items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: And he died, and he turned it over to Lester Mapp. They both were West Indian.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. The man is dead now. His name was Lester Mapp. But the time Sid started to work in this particular place at Kernan Jackson Street, there was another West Indian on the place by the name of Lou Purcell. And he died, and he turned it over to Lester Mapp. They both were West Indian. But Lester was working for Lou. So Sid just continued to stay there. It was at Kernan Jackson Street, San Francisco.
It was really almost part of the old Barbary Coast. It was. It was. Yes. Some Alabama, too.
